name: Entertainment
description: Dates and times from film, television, music and the people who make them: release dates for movies and series, monthly streaming lineups, award shows and their nominations, concert and festival dates, and the life and career timelines of notable performers when they die. Each date comes from the studio, network, streaming service, award organizer or the performer's representatives, and start times are given in Eastern Time and converted to the other US time zones. Rumored release windows and leaked schedules are not reported as dates until the company confirms them, and a death is reported only after family, representatives or a reliable outlet confirms it. Stories link to the monthly and yearly printable calendars so readers can mark a premiere, a finale or an awards night ahead of time.
